responses.draft_cover_letter:
My background in software development has given me a solid foundation for building reliable, user‑focused applications. I am enthusiastic about applying this experience to create iPhone and Apple Watch apps that help Pebble Fitness users reach their health goals.

I am keen to deepen my expertise in Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Core Data, and HealthKit, and I look forward to learning the full App Store release process under the guidance of your team. My commitment to rapid learning and delivering quality code will enable me to contribute effectively from day one.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my drive and adaptability can support Pebble Fitness’ mission in Brighton.
